programs.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programs.desc: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers. Their new friend, April O'Neil, helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programs.title: On Swift Horses
programs.desc: Muriel and her husband, Lee, begin a new life together after he returns home from the Korean War. However, their newfound stability gets upended by the arrival of Lee's charismatic brother, a wayward gambler with a secret past.

programs.title: Love Island
programs.desc: Singles come together in a tropical location to look for romance, with one couple winning a cash prize.

programs.title: The Bride!
programs.desc: A scientist revives a murdered woman as a companion for a legendary creature. The aftermath defies all expectations.

programs.title: Hair of the Bear
programs.desc: Suffering from debilitating anxiety and refusing to go to school, 16-year-old Tori is driven to stay with her grandfather in a remote frozen wilderness but unexpectedly finds herself caught up in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programs.title: Dave Merheje: I Love You Habibi
programs.desc: Dave Merheje talks about family, therapy, and his Dad's porn watching habits.

programs.title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
programs.desc: The golden retriever joins a middle-school baseball team and searches for his missing offspring.

programs.title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
programs.desc: A dog that plays volleyball helps investigators solve a rash of mysterious crimes.

programs.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever
programs.desc: The Herdmans are six siblings who have a reputation for being the worst kids in the world. However, when they take over the local church pageant during the holidays, they just might teach a shocked community the true meaning of Christmas.

programs.title: Soul on Fire
programs.desc: A tragic accident leaves 9-year-old John O'Leary with burns covering 100% of his body. He soon embarks on a miraculous road to recovery with support from family, the community, and baseball announcer Jack Buck. Grateful for the gift of life, John becomes a motivational speaker who inspires millions of people to make the world a better place.

programs.title: Night of the Zoopocalypse
programs.desc: When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.

programs.title: From Russia With Love
programs.desc: Agent 007 (Sean Connery) is back in the second installment of the James Bond series, this time battling a secret crime organization known as SPECTRE. Russians Rosa Klebb (Lotte Lenya) and Kronsteen are out to snatch a decoding device known as the Lektor, using the ravishing Tatiana (Daniela Bianchi) to lure Bond into helping them. Bond willingly travels to meet Tatiana in Istanbul, where he must rely on his wits to escape with his life in a series of deadly encounters with the enemy.
